Hero_Desc_Patula:
An apprentice baker at Sprite Kingdom's bakery district.
She dreams of becoming the best pastry chef one day as she learns from different bakers, including Ashur.
Her personality is not that great since she is always so volatile.
Album_Hate_Patula: Other Apostles who take cooking lightly
Album_Patula7: I asked Patula whether she wanted to open a shop bearing her own name, but she said no. When I asked what she did want, she replied that her dream was to become such an outstanding patissier that everyone would think of Patula whenever the word came up. Saying she had to keep working toward that goal today, she diligently kneaded her dough.

for culinary training?

so I'll take that

Food_ChefNote_Patula_Hate1: Declaring that this should not be called food, Patula threw the can away. She says food that has not been cooked is not food at all.
Food_ChefNote_Patula_Hate2: She disliked it, saying that while it was nutritionally adequate, everything tasted the same and there was no pleasure in eating it.
Food_ChefNote_Patula_Like1: She absolutely loved it, saying that its sweetness felt strong enough to melt her teeth, while the slight refreshing note amplified that sweetness even further.
Food_ChefNote_Patula_Like2: She raised a thumb and declared that strawberry cake was the finest kind of cake. Patula looked blissful with a mouthful of it.
Food_ChefNote_Patula_Like3: She marveled at how fascinating food from Earth was after one bite, then took another bite and marveled all over again.
Food_ChefNote_Patula_Like4: She grumbled that mushrooms would make more fitting decorations for a tree, then ate it with tremendous enthusiasm. Why complain when she enjoys it so much?
Food_ChefNote_Patula_Like5: She said Saekom Vita-F was the best thing for nights spent researching recipes, swallowed it in one gulp, and burst into tears.
Food_ChefNote_Patula_Like6: She asked for the secret behind its many colors. When I teased her by telling her to work it out herself, she grabbed all the songpyeon and ran away.
Food_ChefNote_Patula_Like7: She said she would never slice almonds this way, then lectured me at length on the proper method.
Food_ChefNote_Patula_Like8: After delivering a sermon on the difference between Saekom Vita-F and Yum-Yum Vita-C, Patula concluded that both were delicious and happily finished the Yum-Yum Vita-C.
Food_ChefNote_Patula_Like9: Patula stared wistfully at the Esimdang Ball Candy for quite some time. She ate one and shed tears of emotion, then told me not to ask why. What could the reason be...?

LoveLetter_Patula:
Hello, Master. It is Patula.
I am writing to thank you.
Honestly, I had been worried lately that my bread-making skills had stopped improving, but seeing you enjoy my bread gave me fresh energy. I suppose I realized that cooking brings the greatest happiness when someone else eats what you make.
So I would like you to eat more of my bread from now on. Starting tomorrow, I will bring three loaves to the Order every day, and you can eat them in front of me! I trust you to provide a suitably good reaction.
I will see you tomorrow!
LoveCall_Patula:
Hello, Master. It is Patula.
Why am I calling so suddenly? Well...

You know that I have been working to master all kinds of cooking techniques, right?
A few days ago, I was reading another cookbook. On its final page, it said that the finest dish is one prepared for someone else!
Reading that made me realize that until now, perhaps I have only cooked food that tastes good to me.

So this time, I want to prepare something for you, Master!
What flavor do you like best? What is your favorite ingredient?
Tell me, and I will combine that ingredient with mint chocolate to create a brand-new dish just for you!

Until you tell me, I will keep training even harder, so do not be shy. You must give me an answer!
You absolutely must~!
Affinity_Patula_EP01_002: How about a sweet brunch set?
Affinity_Patula_EP01_003: Yes! Your first meal should always be something extremely~ sweet. Sprinkle lots of sugar on it!
Affinity_Patula_EP01_005: Please give me a menu first. Hmm... Do you not have a separate brunch menu? This restaurant is not very good...
Affinity_Patula_EP01_006: Why do you not cook for yourself...?
Affinity_Patula_EP01_007: Food cooked by someone else is the best!
Affinity_Patula_EP02_001: Master, be honest with me. You cannot cook, can you?
Affinity_Patula_EP02_002: I am probably not as good as you.
Affinity_Patula_EP02_003: Uh... Hehe. Hehehe... You recognize my skill... Your cooking is not too bad either, Master.
Affinity_Patula_EP02_005: Hmm... You are only reasonably good, yet you run such a large restaurant...? Is this the power of authority...?
Affinity_Patula_EP02_006: Try eating something that is not sweet once in a while.
Affinity_Patula_EP02_007: Uuuh! No! Give me sweet food! Food without sweetness tastes terrible!
Affinity_Patula_EP03_001: I started my first restaurant job and was fired that very morning...
Affinity_Patula_EP03_002: Was it a restaurant that did not need a patissier?
Affinity_Patula_EP03_003: Oh, I went there as an assistant chef, not a patissier. Ah~ Was I fired because it was not my specialty? Heehee, my self-esteem has recovered a little!
Affinity_Patula_EP03_004: You covered the food in sugar again, did you not?
Affinity_Patula_EP03_005: Do you think I only ever sprinkle sugar on things?! Please stop suspecting me of that!
Affinity_Patula_EP03_007: Oh, how did you know? Haaah~ I thought I would learn some unusual cooking methods, so it is a shame.
Affinity_Patula_EP04_001: Master, would you like to have a cooking competition with me?
Affinity_Patula_EP04_003: What? That is not fair. We should bring in a separate judge and have them choose the menu!
Affinity_Patula_EP04_005: Hehe... So you have always thought I was a novice. I will show you just how spicy I can be!!!!
Affinity_Patula_EP04_006: Instead of competing, how about researching together?
Affinity_Patula_EP04_007: Oh... Cooking research together... I like that! It sounds more productive than a competition! Just what I would expect from you, Master!
Affinity_Patula_EP05_001: Can you distinguish salt from sugar by sight alone, Master?
Affinity_Patula_EP05_002: I cannot, so I write the names on their containers.
Affinity_Patula_EP05_003: Right~! I knew... it was difficult. Haaah... I put salt into bread instead of sugar recently... Ugh... It tasted dreadful...
Affinity_Patula_EP05_005: R-really...? Truly...? Uuuh... Perhaps I have not mastered the basics...
Affinity_Patula_EP05_006: You have to dip a finger in and taste it.
Affinity_Patula_EP05_007: Ahaha! So you do that too, Master? Uuuh~ One of my labels fell off recently, so I dipped in and tasted it too!
Affinity_Patula_EP06_001: Have you seen my frying pan?
Affinity_Patula_EP06_002: That piece of scrap metal was a frying pan?
Affinity_Patula_EP06_003: S-scrap metal?! That is cruel! That frying pan was practically my oldest friend!
Affinity_Patula_EP06_005: Wow, it sparkles! Thank you, Master. Hehe... This is my cherished frying pan, perfectly fitted to my hand.
Affinity_Patula_EP06_007: Where did it go... My beloved frying pan! Without it, my skill drops by about 0.5 percent!
Affinity_Patula_EP07_001: Master~ Do you need a part-time kitchen worker?
Affinity_Patula_EP07_003: What good timing! I just got fired from my other job, so I have plen... I mean! I have a little free time and can help you. Hehe.
Affinity_Patula_EP07_005: That was very decisive. Hmph, passing up an excellent worker like me... You will regret it soon!
Affinity_Patula_EP07_007: Ngh... Yes. I threw out a customer who said my food tasted bad, and they threw me out with them.
Affinity_Patula_EP08_001: Breadmaking and pastrymaking are completely different fields.
Affinity_Patula_EP08_003: Oh, truly? Hehe~ Oh dear, oh dear~ It seems I will have to teach you the difference between breadmaking and pastrymaking, Master.
Affinity_Patula_EP08_004: I knew that. Cake is a pastry!
Affinity_Patula_EP08_005: Oh... Hmm... So you did know. Hmph, most people think cake counts as bread. Just what I would expect from you, Master...
Affinity_Patula_EP08_006: Any Sprite who does not know that is no Sprite.
Affinity_Patula_EP08_007: I-is that not far too harsh?! I only learned it recently! How cruel!
Affinity_Patula_EP09_001: Hmm, would it be better to dig into only one thing?
Affinity_Patula_EP09_003: What? Why would I dig a hole?! I mean a field of cooking. Hmm~ I am actually a patissier!
Affinity_Patula_EP09_004: It is probably best to dig into your specialty first.
Affinity_Patula_EP09_005: I suppose so...? Haaah, I should master one thing before trying something new... Learning this dish and that dish lately has left me feeling like I am neither one thing nor the other.
Affinity_Patula_EP09_007: Oh, I am sorry! I was talking about fields of cooking. Whether to make pastries... or bake bread... Hmm~ It is difficult to choose.
Affinity_Patula_EP10_001: I am developing a new meal-kit menu!
Affinity_Patula_EP10_002: Give me some when the new one is ready.
Affinity_Patula_EP10_003: Heehee, all right. Look forward to it. I will return with a wonderful meal kit!
Affinity_Patula_EP10_004: If I have a good idea, I will tell you.
Affinity_Patula_EP10_005: Gasp, truly? Wonderful! I was already wondering how to compose the menu.
Affinity_Patula_EP10_006: Please, just do not make everything sweet.
Affinity_Patula_EP10_007: Haaah... Master. You keep criticizing sweetness... but sweetness is the very foundation of Sprite cuisine. The foundation!
Affinity_Patula_EP11_001: Someone ate my food and said it tasted terrible!!
Affinity_Patula_EP11_002: They have no sense of taste.
Affinity_Patula_EP11_003: Mm. Exactly. It was some Elf passing by. Perhaps it is because they only drank bitter coffee without a hint of sweetness.
Affinity_Patula_EP11_005: What? Why? What is that expression? Master, would you please look me in the eyes when you answer?
Affinity_Patula_EP11_006: Let us respect the diversity of people's tastes.
Affinity_Patula_EP11_007: I-if you put it that way... Uuuh... A-all right. I will make food that satisfies everyone's palate!
Affinity_Patula_EP12_001: Kyuri gave me a huge pile of cucumbers.
Affinity_Patula_EP12_003: Uh... Hmm... Was that an impression of Kyuri?
Affinity_Patula_EP12_004: They would make a nice cucumber face pack.
Affinity_Patula_EP12_005: Master... If you do that with food, will the cucumbers not resent you? Will it not hurt their feelings?
Affinity_Patula_EP12_006: Today's side dish is seasoned cucumber salad.
Affinity_Patula_EP12_007: Is that different from salad? Oh... You season it to be sweet and sour? It sounds delicious! Please hurry and make it!
Affinity_Patula_EP13_001: Are you a picky eater too, Master?
Affinity_Patula_EP13_003: Mm-hmm. Yes, that is how a cook should be. An excellent attitude!
Affinity_Patula_EP13_005: It is bad... but perhaps because I am a Sprite, food without sweetness feels difficult to eat... or simply unappealing...
Affinity_Patula_EP13_007: Hmm? Does that mean you are picky? Ah~ You simply eat more of some things and less of others. Hehe... Then would you like to try this? My newest dessert!
Affinity_Patula_EP14_001: I keep telling you, the more sugar, the better!
Affinity_Patula_EP14_002: It truly is wonderful when you are stressed.
Affinity_Patula_EP14_003: Exactly. Pair a sweet dessert with sweet tea~ and your blood sugar shoots up, making you happy. Yawn~ I feel a little sleepy now. May I sleep?
Affinity_Patula_EP14_004: Would moderation not be best in everything?
Affinity_Patula_EP14_005: Hmm, is that so? Well~ Sweet-and-sour food is delicious sometimes. Sweet-and-spicy food too. Hmm? It feels as if we are simply adding other flavors to sweetness?
Affinity_Patula_EP14_006: I cannot agree with that opinion.
Affinity_Patula_EP14_007: Why? Why not? Master, are you discriminating against traditional Sprite cuisine? Is that it?
Affinity_Patula_EP15_001: Cooking utensils made by the Elves are a little lower in quality than I expected...
Affinity_Patula_EP15_002: Are you certain you do not handle them roughly?
Affinity_Patula_EP15_003: What are you saying?! What kind of cook would mistreat precious cooking utensils instead of cherishing them?!
Affinity_Patula_EP15_004: Shall I introduce you to a good craftsperson?
Affinity_Patula_EP15_005: Gasp, truly? You know a craftsperson? Then please introduce me! Please!
Affinity_Patula_EP15_006: It is because they are factory-made.
Affinity_Patula_EP15_007: Ngh... Is this the harm of mass production...? I suppose I should replace them regularly as I use them.
Affinity_Patula_EP16_001: I am considering leaving on a culinary training journey.
Affinity_Patula_EP16_002: Some fresh ingredients just arrived. Take them with you.
Affinity_Patula_EP16_003: Gasp...! Master... I am truly moved. You are giving me ingredients of such quality... I promise to return after improving my skills!
Affinity_Patula_EP16_004: Good luck! I am cheering for you.
Affinity_Patula_EP16_005: Thank you for your support. I am considering the Ghost Swamp, since it has many varieties of pumpkin. What do you think? Uh... Wh-why are you making that face?
Affinity_Patula_EP16_006: Are you not simply going camping?
Affinity_Patula_EP16_007: Hmph. If you keep being that perceptive, the road at night may become dangerous, Master.
Affinity_Patula_EP17_001: Master, I made you a delicious lunch box!
Affinity_Patula_EP17_002: Thank you. I will enjoy it!
Affinity_Patula_EP17_003: Yes, yes. Enjoy it and tell me what you think. Hehe~ It is my newest dessert lunch box!
Affinity_Patula_EP17_005: Is there a law saying cake cannot be a lunch-box menu? Why! What?!
Affinity_Patula_EP17_006: The decoration is a work of art.
Affinity_Patula_EP17_007: You noticed? I used sweet-and-sour strawberries found only in the Elemental Forest and pumpkin pastry filling that I barely managed to obtain in the Ghost Swamp! What do you think of the colors? Pretty, are they not?
Affinity_Patula_EP18_001: I visited the cities of other races to broaden my horizons.
Affinity_Patula_EP18_002: I am so jealous of your culinary tour.
Affinity_Patula_EP18_003: Heehee, jealous? I went around eating all sorts of things, and it was wonderful. Come with me next time, Master!
Affinity_Patula_EP18_004: Show me the results of your training!
Affinity_Patula_EP18_005: All right! May I borrow the kitchen? I will show you the results of my training immediately.
Affinity_Patula_EP18_006: Are desserts not all more or less the same?
Affinity_Patula_EP18_007: ...They are completely different. Just look at the Witch Kingdom. They fry carrots there!
Affinity_Patula_EP19_001: I burned my hand while making sugar art.
Affinity_Patula_EP19_002: I happen to have excellent burn ointment.
Affinity_Patula_EP19_003: Oh... I was wondering whether I needed to go all the way to the hospital in Monatium. I will put it to good use. Thank you!
Affinity_Patula_EP19_004: Your fighting spirit despite the injury is admirable.
Affinity_Patula_EP19_005: Hehe... Hehehe! Master, would you like to see my work? If I place this sugar art atop this strawberry cake... Ahh... It looks incredible, right? Right?! Hahaha!!!
Affinity_Patula_EP19_007: Hmph... That can happen when I concentrate. You did not even compliment my wonderful work... How cruel!
Affinity_Patula_EP20_001: Master~ Please lend me a whetstone!
Affinity_Patula_EP20_003: What? I am disappointed in you, Master. You should sharpen your knives on a whetstone every day! Do you not even observe such a basic practice?
Affinity_Patula_EP20_004: I have a spare, so simply take it.
Affinity_Patula_EP20_005: R-really...? May I have such a fine whetstone? Thank you, Master!
Affinity_Patula_EP20_006: You plan to use it on a spatula...?
Affinity_Patula_EP20_007: What? What an amusing joke. What use would a sharpened spatula be? Uh... Huh? Wait, perhaps it would be rather useful...?
